note: Adapted from Maiti 2006; original in English; the text notes 'Measurements: Table 14 (S.)', but Table 14 actually covers bentongensis and sepangensis, the measurements of this species are in Table 13 and were taken from Table 13. The antenna segment row in Table 13 is a single value and is not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head oval, long and narrow, resembling C. sepangensis but smaller, narrower and thinner; mandibles short, the tips incurved; antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 slightly shorter than or equal to segment 4; postmentum short, strongly contracted at the middle; pronotum flat, narrower than the head, distinctly wider than long, anterior margin convex and slightly raised, with a median notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Abdomen densely hairy, with a row of hairs along the posterior margin. Head oval, long and narrow, resembling C. sepangensis but smaller, narrower and thinner; mandibles short, the tips incurved; antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 slightly shorter than or equal to segment 4; postmentum short, strongly contracted at the middle; pronotum flat, narrower than the head, distinctly wider than long, anterior margin convex and slightly raised with a median notch, sides sloping down and rather straight or rounded, posterior margin weakly concave. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.10—1.13; maximum head width 0.90—0.98; anterior head width 0.50; head index 0.80—0.87; labrum length 0.28—0.30, width 0.23; mandible length 0.73—0.78; head—mandible index 0.65; postmentum midlength 0.75—0.83, maximum width 0.35—0.38, waist width 0.20—0.21; pronotum length 0.33—0.36, width 0.58—0.63; pronotum index 0.58; pronotum/head width index 0.62—0.68.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Tamil Nadu, India. The material studied is a vial of specimens (No. 199) in F.R.I. Dehra Dun, containing the holotype soldier collected by G. Baker on 1956-11-05.
